from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass
class Box:
    items: list = field(default_factory=list)

first = Box()
second = Box()
first.items.append("Map")
print(first.items)
print(second.items)

from contextlib import contextmanager

@contextmanager
def marked(log):
    log.append("begin")
    try:
        yield "inside"
    finally:
        log.append("end")

log = []
with marked(log) as value:
    print(value)
print(log)
